title: Check Desk location records
description: One row per physical place that offers at least one in-scope service. Every factual field that is filled must be supportable by source_urls and last_verified. last_verified is required on every row, including policy_only_call_ahead rows. Example rows must set is_example=true and must not be published.

id.description: Stable slug. Example rows must start with 'ex-'.

name.description: Public location name as the official locator or official page lists it.

brand.description: Chain or independent brand key, e.g. walmart, usps, king_soopers, ace_cash_express, western_union, moneygram, independent.

lat.description: Only from a cited public source (official locator or Census). Null if unknown.

phone.description: Public phone only, as published on an official page or official locator. Never a number collected by calling the store. Null if not published.

hours_mon.description: Published hours for Monday, e.g. '09:00-19:00' or 'closed'. Null if not published.

hours_notes.description: Holiday or 'hours may vary' language copied from the source.

after_hours.description: True if any published service window is outside Mon-Fri 09:00-17:00 America/Denver. Null if hours are not published.

fee_notes.description: Quote or close paraphrase of official fee language for this brand or location. If the official page says fees vary and posts no number, say that. Never invent a typical range.

id_requirements.description: ID or enrollment rules as the official page states them.

source_urls.description: One or more official source URLs, separated by ' | ' in the CSV.

last_verified.description: Required. America/Denver calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) the cited sources were last opened. Required even when verification_status is policy_only_call_ahead or unverified (for unverified example rows, use a clearly dummy date such as 1900-01-01).

verification_status.description: unverified: not yet checked against an official source (do not publish). policy_only_call_ahead: official chain/policy known, this store not individually verified; tell the reader to call ahead. verified_official_locator: address/hours/services confirmed on the official locator. verified_official_store_page: confirmed on that location's own official page.

verified_by.description: Person or agent identifier who opened the sources, e.g. 'RC' or 'checkdesk-step4'.

confidence.description: high: official locator or official store page for address/hours/services, plus official fee page or an explicit 'no price published' note. medium: official locator for the place but hours or services incomplete. low: lead from a non-official index, not yet confirmed on an official locator — do not publish.

is_example.description: Must be true for any fictional or illustrative row. Published site builds must drop rows where is_example is true.
